Headline: Forest Park-bound Blue Line Service Delayed Western-oh
ShortDescription: Forest Park-bound Blue Line Passengers we are being delayed at Western-oh due to an earlier door problem. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Attention Forest Park-bound Blue Line Passengers we are being delayed at Western-oh due to an earlier door problem.

At this time we are unloading the delayed train. An immediate follower will be arriving shortly. Crews are working to correct this problem. We apologize for any inconvenience and we appreciate your patience.

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
